note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: At 1:1 the rail lines and bolts are soft, smeared into blurry blobs; the grey panel loses the original's crisp edge detail.
flags.fix: Re-run with less lab-inject smoothing on rail and bolt edges (sigma t/48 rel .10 looks too strong); sharpen the rail lines.

flags.problem: Lens highlight pairs are smeared with bright halos, and the label block turns into a blur at 1:1.
flags.fix: Reduce lab-inject strength (rel .06) around the lens and label areas; check the thin dark hairlines in the centre crop against the original.
